title: The Fall of the House of Usher
description: You come to Roderick Usher at his desperate letter. A house by a dark tarn, a crack down its front, his sister Madeline like a shadow. Something is ending here — and you will be beside him when it does.
line: An old friend calls you to a house that seems to be ill along with its masters.
source: after the tale by Edgar Allan Poe
